visual.title: Rotating a shape about the origin
visual.caption: Add, remove or drag vertices to build the polygon, then transform it. The dashed outline is yours, the filled outline is its image, and an isometry keeps every side length while a dilation does not.

predict.question: Build a shape, then choose Dilation with a scale above 1. What happens to the side lengths?
options: They all scale by the same factor
predict.explain: A dilation multiplies every vector by the same k, so every side length is multiplied by |k| and the area by k squared.
